svg.title: Inside /tk:create-plan
svg.desc: Create-plan follows explore on its own. It reads the codebase map, the lessons and your project's plan gate, then writes the plan, giving every step a check that must fail before the work and pass after it. A lint confirms every check line can run. A plan critic with fresh eyes, given only the plan and the exploration summary, names the biggest gaps; they are fixed, for up to 2 rounds, and gaps from round 2 are carried to review. An HTML page shows the plan, and you approve it. Execute never starts on its own.
